# netbox_module (Data Source)

Retrieves a single module from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_module" "example" {
  id        = 1
  device_id = 1
}

output "module_id" {
  value = data.netbox_module.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `asset_tag` (String) The asset tag of the module.
- `device_id` (Number) The ID of the device associated with the module.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the module.
- `module_bay_id` (Number) The ID of the module bay associated with the module.
- `module_type_id` (Number) The ID of the module type associated with the module.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the module.
- `serial` (String) The serial of the module.
- `status` (String) The status of the module.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the module.
- `created` (String) When the module was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the module, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the module.
- `is_bay_compatible` (Boolean) The is bay compatible of the module.
- `last_updated` (String) When the module was last changed.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
